wiki.title: Kurtis Gregory
wiki.extract: Kurtis Gregory (born August 7, 1986) is an American politician serving as a member of the Missouri Senate since 2025. Before that he was in the Missouri House of Representatives from the 51st district. A Republican, he has served since 2021. Gregory attended the University of Missouri, where he played college football for the Tigers.
